user.title: Connect PSP Streamer
user.description: Enter the server URL (not the PSP address). The PSP may be offline during setup.

reconfigure.title: Update connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the current password again, or leave it empty only if the server has no password.

reauth_confirm.title: Update password
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current server URL and password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or server API is too old. Update the server to 0.1.44 or later and check the URL and TLS certificate.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address belongs to a different PSP Streamer server.
